description: The Pine Script® source code of a Library indicator. Kept separate from library_get_indicator because sources are long — call it only when the user wants the code itself. For some indicators the app returns only the start of the source to a signed-out user (`complete: false`, with the line counts): signing in to a LuxAlgo account, free included, returns all of it. `chart_url` opens the indicator on Vela either way.
name: library_get_source_code
title: Get an indicator's source code
